issues.description: The problem statement and solution expect Course to be initializable with three parameters (name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) — see the example initializer in the problem statement. The template's Course initializer only accepts name and instructor (no ratings parameter) and initializes properties with empty/default values. This constructor signature mismatch is structural: students following the problem text (or the solution) will expect to call Course(name:instructor:ratings:) but the template does not provide that initializer, which prevents straightforward implementation and testing in the provided starter code.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the template Course initializer to accept the ratings parameter and assign all properties from the initializer parameters. For example: init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) { self.name = name; self.instructor = instructor; self.ratings = ratings } This aligns the template with the problem statement and the solution and removes a blocker for students.
